step1_analysis.description: A passive network consisting of capacitors and resistors, likely acting as a high-pass filter, AC coupling network, or signal splitter for an RF front-end.

paper_reference.title: A 2.4-GHz-Band 1.8-V Operation Single-Chip Si-CMOS T/R-MMIC Front-End with a Low Insertion Loss Switch

insertion_loss_2g4.description: Insertion loss of the passive network at the 2.4 GHz operating frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on component values. Assuming C=1pF and R=50 ohms, the network acts as a high-pass filter. At 2.4 GHz, the impedance of 1pF is ~66 ohms, leading to some attenuation.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Passive networks have an insertion loss <= 0 dB. The exact value depends on the chosen R and C values for the target frequency.

cutoff_frequency.description: -3dB cutoff frequency of the high-pass filter paths.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_c = 1 / (2 * pi * R * C). For R=50 ohms, C=1pF, f_c ≈ 3.18 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The cutoff frequency should be designed to pass the 2.4 GHz band while rejecting lower frequency noise or DC.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure the frequency response, insertion loss at 2.4 GHz, and cutoff frequency of the passive network.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Passive High-Pass Filter / Splitter Testbench

* Component parameters (assumed for 2.4GHz operation)
.param C_val=1p
.param R_val=50

* DUT
C1 n1 n2 {C_val}
C2 n0 n3 {C_val}
R1 n2 GND {R_val}
R2 n1 GND {R_val}
R3 n3 GND {R_val}
C3 n0 n1 {C_val}

* Stimulus
Vin n0 GND dc 0 ac 1

.control
* AC Analysis from 100 MHz to 10 GHz
ac dec 100 100Meg 10G

* Calculate dB magnitudes
let v_n2_db = vdb(n2)
let v_n3_db = vdb(n3)

* Measure insertion loss at 2.4 GHz
meas ac il_n2_2g4 find v_n2_db at=2.4G
meas ac il_n3_2g4 find v_n3_db at=2.4G

* Measure -3dB cutoff frequencies (assuming 0dB passband gain)
meas ac f3db_n2 when v_n2_db=-3 fall=1
meas ac f3db_n3 when v_n3_db=-3 fall=1

print il_n2_2g4 il_n3_2g4 f3db_n2 f3db_n3
quit
.endc
.end
